Robert Pattinson Reportedly Cast as New James Bond

British actor Robert Pattinson has reportedly been named the new James Bond. His casting follows a history of actors who have portrayed the iconic spy, including Sean Connery, Daniel Craig, and others. Pattinson, known for roles in 'Twilight' and as Bruce Wayne, has also been described as a 'perfect' choice for the role by co-star Elizabeth Debicki. Amazon CEO Jeff Bezos revealed he was initially hesitant about Pattinson due to his existing fame but was heavily involved in the casting process. The casting also raises questions about the franchise's history of casting white actors for the role over 64 years.
